comment: Packages the builder may install on demand. Anything not listed here is refused: an open `pnpm add` is an unpinned supply chain, an unpredictable disk footprint and a way to break a build with a package that wants a native toolchain. Keep entries to pure-JS, browser-side packages. `weight` is a guide for the caller: heavy entries add build time and disk, so a site should justify them.

packages.name: motion
packages.why: Animation (the framer-motion successor). Use only when the design asks for movement.

packages.name: date-fns
packages.why: Formatting dates on news, events and opening-hours pages.

packages.name: dayjs
packages.why: Smaller alternative to date-fns when only formatting is needed.

packages.name: @heroicons/react
packages.why: Alternative icon set when lucide-react does not have the right glyph.

packages.name: @headlessui/react
packages.why: Accessible menus, comboboxes and transitions without Radix.

packages.name: leaflet
packages.why: Embedded maps. Needs react-leaflet with it and a tile source.

packages.name: react-leaflet
packages.why: React bindings for leaflet. Requires leaflet.

packages.name: recharts
packages.why: Charts for a page that genuinely shows data. Pulls d3 modules.
